environment.description: Same EC2 instance (m5.large, Amazon Linux 2) but the billing monolith runs inside a lightweight runc container managed by systemd-nspawn with a custom OCI runtime spec. The runtime spec includes a seccomp profile (applied via libseccomp BPF filter at container init) that operates in whitelist mode with SCMP_ACT_ERRNO(EPERM) as default action. The allowed syscall set includes read, write, open, openat, close, fstat, lstat, stat, lseek, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, access, pipe, dup2, getpid, getuid, clock_gettime, nanosleep, futex, epoll_wait, fcntl, ioctl, rename, unlink, mkdir, chmod, fchmod, chdir, getcwd, exit_group, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, arch_prctl, set_tid_address, set_robust_list — but explicitly EXCLUDES execve, execveat, clone (with CLONE_NEWUSER), ptrace, socket, connect, bind, listen, accept, sendto, recvfrom, fork, vfork. The container's /tmp is a private tmpfs mount (MS_PRIVATE) not shared with host. Additionally, the container runs with no_new_privs bit set via PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS.

config.note: seccomp BPF loaded at container init before any application code runs
